constraints.decision: What organizing does: Move only the files directly in Downloads into folders by kind, such as images, documents and archives; never delete, rename or overwrite any file
Why it is wanted: Make the wanted file easy to find in a cluttered Downloads folder; the user runs it by hand when they feel like it
What shows it done: Tests on a test folder, never the real Downloads folder, check AC1 to AC6 and AC9; a README gives install and usage
Files of no known kind: A top-level file of no known kind, such as one with no extension or an unfamiliar one, moves into an Other folder
Undoing the last run: The user can undo the last run, which moves each file that run moved back to where it was; the tests check this
Undo where the name is taken: Where a file of the same name is already at the place a file would go back to, undo leaves that file in its kind folder and reports it
Folders left empty by undo: Undo removes each kind folder that run made once it is empty, leaving folders that were there before or still hold a file
UX document: The purpose needs a UX, docs/ux.md, of kind ux
README document: The purpose needs a README, the repository's README.md rewritten for the tool, of kind readme
Architecture document: The purpose needs an architecture, docs/architecture.md, of kind architecture
